# LibreSky

> A free Bluesky client in the browser. Edit posts, search what people are saying, chat, and start a voice or video call. Ask @ai in the same window.

LibreSky is open source under the MIT license. Sign in with a Bluesky account. The password stays with Bluesky. Voice and video calls run between two open LibreSky windows. Linux, Windows, and Mac builds are on the download page inside the app.

## Features

- Edit posts
- AI with @ai and @si
- Voice calls
- Video calls
- Chat
- Home, Discover, and search
- Notifications, bookmarks, and profiles
- Feeds, lists, and starter packs
- Follow back and follow cleanup
- Desktop apps for Linux, Windows, and Mac
